text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon finishes running the NHK 
Mile Cup."

Following the racing schedule, the Trainer 
suggests to Agnes Tachyon that they aim 
for the Kikuka Sho.

Though agreeing, Agnes Tachyon left the 
venue with parting words not to get their 
hopes up.

With lingering uncertainty over whether 
her whimsical self would truly run in the 
Kikuka Sho, the days leading up to their 
next objective were about to begin.
